what: Test 16 codex stub and post-run assertion still use tmpdir-root qa-pending.json; plan table only retargets STEP2_MANIFEST_PATH for test 16
scenario_or_breakage: After CODER=codex moves QA_PENDING_PATH to $TMPDIR/codex-step2-out/qa-pending.json, stub writes items[] to $IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/qa-pending.json and assertion reads $TMP16/qa-pending.json; dispatcher repair reads the subdir path and sees missing/wrong file → test 16 fails (qa-pending-missing or wrong STATUS) despite table listing test 16
suggested_fix: Extend the test-step2-dispatch.sh plan for test 16: stub writes to $IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/codex-step2-out/qa-pending.json (or dirname of STEP2_MANIFEST_PATH); set QA_PENDING_16=$TMP16/codex-step2-out/qa-pending.json
